timing: Unassigned. Parent must review this whole revised candidate before any voice work; concrete timing requires actual approved speech.

spans.text: Unit checklists help vehicle crews keep each check tied to the right apparatus and form. Here, Engine 51 is selected. Open Checklists and look under Start checklist.
spans.purpose: Actual selected vehicle and checklist entry for the intended audience.

spans.text: Find Engine 51 daily readiness, then choose the Engine 51 button directly beneath it. The Ambulance 61 form offers a same-named target button, so match both the form and vehicle before starting.
spans.purpose: Actual correct target button beneath the intended definition; distinguish the other form.

spans.text: The form opens for Engine 51, Version 1. Equipment ready for the exercise is the first item, marked Required and Critical.
spans.purpose: Actual first item, target and version.

spans.text: Choose Pass for this training run and add a Note explaining that this is a software walkthrough and no physical inspection was performed. That context makes the simulated answer clear to the next reader. Check the note, then choose Next.
spans.purpose: Actual selected software-only Pass, complete item note and Next.

spans.text: Stock and supplies recorded is item two. Choose Pass and add a supplies-specific note that keeps the answer within the exercise.
spans.purpose: Actual second item, selected Pass and software-exercise supplies note.

spans.text: An item note should explain that particular answer, so the next crew member can understand what was recorded. Confirm the heading and answer, then choose Next. Use the same review habit for a patrol kit or SAR cache with your team's published form.
spans.purpose: Actual heading/answer/Next plus hypothetical sector use of the same review habit.

spans.text: The third item is Handover notes reviewed. Choose Pass and record the fictional handover context in the item's Note.
spans.purpose: Actual third item, selected Pass and handover note.

spans.text: Below the navigation buttons, the general note describes the whole run. Keep its overall training purpose clear; leave the location field blank here.
spans.purpose: Actual whole-run note and blank unlabeled location input; no invented painted label.

spans.text: Choose Save progress to save the unfinished run. The sheet stays open, so choose Close to return to the list and review the saved entry.
spans.purpose: Both actual Save progress and Close controls; parent-observed save does not dismiss the sheet.

spans.text: Local drafts now shows Draft 1. Choose History to load the saved run list, then open the timestamped Engine 51 entry.
spans.purpose: Actual Draft1, History and saved-progress entry.

spans.text: The vehicle and time help you find the work you just saved. Save progress keeps the run available for review before final submission. That matters during handover, when someone needs to check the entered answers before finalizing the record.
spans.purpose: Actual saved-work context and purpose; no submitted state inferred from a list row.

spans.text: The reopened run brings back the first item's Pass answer, equipment note and general note. Read them together and compare them with the intended record before continuing.
spans.purpose: Actual resumed first answer and both notes; no simultaneous three-answer display claim.

spans.text: Save progress and Submit checklist remain available while this is the working run. For a community care vehicle, this review gives the next operator the answer, its explanation and the overall context in one place.
spans.purpose: Actual editable working-run controls and hypothetical community-response use.

spans.text: When the review is complete, choose Submit checklist.
spans.purpose: Actual Submit checklist on the editable resumed run.

spans.text: The sheet changes to Submitted, Score 100. The answer fields are now read-only, and Close remains available. Save progress and Submit checklist are gone. The score is the result of the answers entered in this training form. Read the returned state to confirm that the run has reached submission.
spans.purpose: Actual read-only Submitted/Score100 result, absent editing actions and visible Close.

spans.text: After reopening the run from refreshed History, the submitted result and training notes are still present. Check them before handing the record to another operator.
spans.purpose: Actual final same-tab reopened submitted readback; History is retrospective context, not an unseen foreground control.

spans.text: Carry the same target, answer, note and review habit to a wildland vehicle or industrial support equipment using the appropriate form. This example covers saving and reopening in the same browser tab; offline use, browser restarts and device-location behavior need separate checks.
spans.purpose: Bounded sector transfer and one concise end-of-lesson persistence/native limitation.
